Derusha, who began her post this month, will get something of an official introduction next week at Artadia’s annual New York luncheon, scheduled for September 23 at the National Arts Club. © 2026 Art Media, LLC.

headline: Pem Lham Wins $30k Rubin Museum Himalayan Art Prize
summary: The Rubin Museum of Himalayan Art has named Bhutanese mixed-media artist Pem Lham the winner of the 2026 Rubin Museum Himalayan Art Prize. Pem Lham lives and works in Thimphu, Bhutan. The Rubin Museum Himalayan Art Prize was established in 2024, shortly after the Rubin Museum of Art closed its physical location.

headline: Three Works of Sacred Art Stolen From Spanish Churches as Authorities Warn of Rise in Art Theft
summary: Three works of religious art were stolen from two churches in the Spanish city of Valladolid, the latest in a string of thefts from museums and churches across Spain and Europe. Churches are a particularly easy target. © 2026 Art Media, LLC.

headline: Brooklyn Museum, American Folk Art Museum, and Whitney Museum Unions Vote in Favor of Strikes
summary: Unionized staff at three New York City cultural institutions—the Brooklyn Museum , the American Folk Art Museum , and the Whitney Museum of American Art —voted in favor of strike action if they do not receive satisfactory offers on their contracts, Local 2110 UAW announced today. Staff at the American Folk Art Museum (Afam) voted unanimously to unionize with UAW Local 2110 in June 2024. © 2026 Art Media, LLC.
